commit.message:
8397000: find_initial_Java_frame should return false for the first frame of upcall

In special cases, an upcall emerges from a new native thread. No prior java
frame is present. FFM upcall stub will attach to JVM and then back to the Java
world.

This patch updates find_initial_Java_frame() of ASGCT. Like entry frame (JNI's
upcall), it detects the upcall stub (FFM upcall) which is the 1st Java frame.
If so, stop probing the initial Java frame and return false immediately. This
fixes two cases in forte_fill_call_trace_given_top():

1. No initial java frame is found. Skip stackwalking because
   initial_Java_frame.safe_for_sender() is false.
2. An initial frame is found. It's not the upcall stub frame, but a java callee.
   vframeStreamCommon::fill_from_frame() will encounter the upcall stub frame,
   set at_end_mode and terminate stackwalking.

This patch doesn't touch the loop under #ifdef ZERO. It is because there's no
upcall stub in zero build. FFM will use FallbackLinker and entry_frame.
